tools.name: get_impacts
tools.description: Retrieve recent impacts, peak magnitude, estimated side and capture quality. Relative helmet-impact telemetry, not a diagnosis; a human trainer decides.

tools.name: flag_for_review
tools.description: Send one iMessage review request for a saved impact to the configured connected conversation. Repeated calls return its delivery status without another message; the first note is retained. Relative helmet-impact telemetry, not a diagnosis; a human trainer decides.

tools.name: show_last_hit
tools.description: Draw the latest saved hit on a top-down helmet with peak magnitude, player and estimated side. Relative helmet-impact telemetry, not a diagnosis; a human trainer decides.
